exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения, начинающиеся с when. Используйте информацию из обеих рамок.
wordBank: I always go to the same place

answers: When I went out, it was raining.
When I’m tired, I like to watch TV.
When I knocked on the door, there was no answer.
When I go on holiday, I always go to the same place.
When the programme ended, I turned off the TV.
When I got to the hotel, there were no rooms.

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения, начинающиеся с if. Используйте информацию из обеих рамок.

answers: If you don’t hurry, you’ll be late.
If you pass the exam, you’ll get a certificate.
If you fail the exam, you can do it again.

If you want those pictures, you can have them.
If you’re busy now, we can talk later.

exercises.instruction: Закончите предложения, используя свои собственные идеи.

items.prompt: Can you close the window before … ?
What are you going to do when … ?
We can go to the beach tomorrow if … .
When I start my new job, … .
modelAnswers: … I won’t have much free time.

items.prompt: Tina won’t pass her exams if … .

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (присматривать за = look after, добраться = get, получить визу = get a visa, сдать = pass)

items.prompt: Ты можешь закрыть окно, если тебе холодно.
answers: You can close the window if you are cold.

items.prompt: Когда будешь говорить с Ричардом, спроси его о его новой работе.
answers: When you speak to Richard, ask him about his new job.
When you talk to Richard, ask him about his new job.

items.prompt: Если мы поедем в Мадрид, мы навестим наших друзей.
answers: If we go to Madrid, we’ll visit our friends.

items.prompt: Мы присмотрим за вашей кошкой, пока вы будете во Франции.
answers: We’ll look after your cat while you’re in France.
We’ll look after your cat while you are in France.

answers: Don’t forget to call me when you get home.

answers: I can speak to Tim tomorrow if he’s busy today.

answers: Ben had to get a visa before he went to China.
